notes: ResetForRestart() is intentionally named to avoid colliding with MonoBehaviour's built-in editor-only Reset() callback.

CastDenied only fires for the insufficient-mana case (amount > CurrentMana); a non-positive amount request still returns false silently as before, since that is a caller-side invalid argument rather than a low-mana failure the player needs to read.

PlayerManaUI's denied-cast flash color/duration are serialized fields with sensible defaults so a scene/prefab owner can retune presentation without further code changes; exact presentation was left as an implementation choice per AC-002.
No test files were modified; PlayerManaPlayModeTests.cs coverage of the new reset entry point and denied-cast signal is expected to be added by a separate validation task per the completion gates.
structured_output.summary: Implemented AC-001/AC-002 in PlayerMana.cs: added a CastDenied event fired from Spend() when a cast is refused due to insufficient mana (kept distinct from the existing ManaSpent event), and added an owner-controlled ResetForRestart() entry point that restores CurrentMana to maxMana and resets the post-cast regen-delay timer. PlayerManaUI.cs now subscribes to CastDenied and briefly flashes the existing fill Image to a denied-cast color, giving the mana indicator readable low-mana failure feedback (VAL-002/VAL-003) without adding new scene-wired UI. AC-003 preserved: no spell-local (Fireball/Frost Field/Force Wave) cooldown/charge/cast/placement/active-field state was touched or absorbed. Did not modify PlayerManaPlayModeTests.cs (denied write path) or any other files; did not run Unity/tests/builds.
